comment.body:
Please provide a newly generated, valid PowerToys bug report ZIP and clarify the failure:

- Confirm the exact Windows edition and version/build shown by winver. The report currently lists `Microsoft Windows NT 6.2.9200.0`; please confirm whether that value is accurate.
- Confirm whether the problem is updating, uninstalling, or both.
- State the exact PowerToys version being installed and the installation scope (per-user or per-machine).
- Provide the installer or bootstrapper error text and the approximate time of the failed attempt.
- Describe whether PowerToys still launches and which version is shown afterward.
- Include the complete installer log if the bug-report tool cannot create a valid archive.

Please also confirm whether the issue reproduces when attempting to install the latest supported PowerToys release.
